filing-grey.note: Warm grey from the ink, 5.4:1 on Archive Cream. Replaces neutral #808080 (3.7:1).

display.purpose: Case-study title only, lowercase. Courier New.

headline.purpose: Project titles on home cards, Courier New 26px (21px mobile).

title.purpose: Margin headings, lab card names, project window title.

body.purpose: Home card descriptions and about text, Courier New 13px/1.65, -0.02em tracking.

body-casestudy.purpose: Case-study running text, Courier New 13px/1.65, -0.02em tracking; two columns for long passages.

typed.purpose: Home intro lines set like a typewritten form, 12px (11px mobile).

meta.purpose: Home tags (italic) and dates (tabular), 11px Filing Grey; recedes by tone, not size.

interface.purpose: Top nav, margin nav, clock, footer, Open Sans 10–12px.

caption.purpose: Figure captions, Courier New italic 11px, Filing Grey.

meta-mono.purpose: Case-study date and credits, the redaction bar, Courier New 11px.

shadows.name: ink-bleed
shadows.purpose: Text on paper only; a printed-ink feel, not elevation. Disabled on typed elements.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: The system is still. State changes (hover inversion, dialog open) are instant.

motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: In-page anchor jumps from the margin nav.

narrative.overview: The system is flat and still on purpose. Nothing animates, nothing floats, and depth is the cream sheet against the white page and nothing else. It has to load fast on a slow mobile connection, so it uses one web font (Open Sans, for the interface), the installed Courier New for everything on paper, and no frameworks.
keyCharacteristics: Cream sheets (Archive Cream) on a white desk, square corners, no shadows
Courier New for everything on paper, as if typed onto the sheet; Open Sans for anything you click or navigate with

Lowercase copy, compact sizes (11–13px for most paper text), generous line-height (1.6–1.7). Hierarchy comes from tone (ink vs. Filing Grey), not size steps: Courier is wide, so every size step costs a lot of room
Margin-gutter headings on case studies, with one redaction-bar highlight per section
Controls are 1px ink outlines that invert to solid ink, with no transitions
A faint blue-grey text-shadow on paper, like ink bleeding into the sheet

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Text is Carbon Ink or Faded Ribbon, and everything else is paper. No accent colours, no coloured links, no tinted panels.

rules.name: The One Redaction Rule
rules.body: Redaction Navy appears once per case-study section, as the highlight bar, and nowhere else. It only works because it's rare.

rules.name: The Grey Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Filing Grey is for dates, tags, captions and inactive nav, never for body copy. Use the warm #6e6558, never a neutral grey: #808080 on cream is only 3.7:1 and fails AA for small text.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Copy is written in lowercase, including titles and tags. Don't title-case or uppercase anything for emphasis.

rules.name: The Typed Paper Rule
rules.body: If it is printed on a sheet, it is Courier New. If you can click it, or it belongs to the browser frame around the sheets (nav, clock, footer), it is Open Sans. The CSS enforces this with one override: links, buttons and the navbar inside a sheet switch back to Open Sans.

rules.name: The Courier Floor Rule
rules.body: Courier New runs small (low x-height, thin strokes, plus the ink-bleed text-shadow), so set it one step larger than a sans would need. No paper text on any page goes below 11px; metadata sits at the 11px floor and recedes by tone (Filing Grey), never by shrinking further.

rules.name: The Empty Paper Rule
rules.body: Sections are separated by whitespace, never by lines, boxes or background changes. If two sections feel like they run together, add space.

rules.name: The Flat File Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Separation is paper against desk, a 1px ink line, or a scrim.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No border-radius anywhere. A rounded corner would read as app UI, not paper.

dos: Do put every surface on Archive Cream (#fff8e6) over Desk White (#ffffff), with square corners and no shadow.
Do set text in Carbon Ink (#2d2822) or Faded Ribbon (#4A4238), and keep Filing Grey (#6e6558) for metadata.
Do set everything printed on a sheet in Courier New, and everything clickable or part of the frame (nav, links, buttons, clock, footer) in Open Sans.
Do separate case-study sections with 120px of empty paper and put the section heading in the 140px left gutter.
Do give each case-study section at most one Redaction Navy (#1E212B) highlight bar.
Do make controls 1px Carbon Ink outlines that invert to a solid ink fill on hover and focus.
donts: Don't add animations, scroll effects, loading screens or interactive toys. The page stays still.
Don't use border-radius, drop shadows, gradients or coloured accents.
Don't use generic SaaS layouts, like hero sections with gradient blobs.
Don't add heavy JS frameworks or extra web fonts. Open Sans plus the installed Courier New (and system monospace for lab controls) is the whole type budget.
Don't use Filing Grey for body copy, and don't set Courier metadata below 11px.
Don't separate sections with horizontal rules or boxed panels. Use empty space.
